comment: Each verdict compares a Lean-owned own-body semantic target and exact paper-local declaration with its selected byte-pinned paper-source bundle. These are semantic prerequisites, not additional paper-claim rows.

LBG22StrategicRanking.EnvironmentEquilib.reason: The target models the two equal-mass groups with common uniform skill rank, group multiplier psiA or psiB, measurable realized score, and one full-measure applicant set that best responds against every deviation. The displayed population, skill, finite-reward, counterfactual-rank, and fixed-priority support matches the group equilibrium source under the approved continuum and priority conventions.

LBG22StrategicRanking.FiniteAdmissionPol.reason: The target requires strictly increasing cutoffs from 0 to 1, strictly increasing rewards in [0,1], capacity rho in (0,1), and the exact band-length-weighted capacity equation. These binders, domains, and formulas match the source finite step policy with K=n+1 reward levels.

LBG22StrategicRanking.MultidimensionalEq.reason: The target states a measurable-score equilibrium in which almost every independently sampled rank vector maximizes finite-band reward minus exchangeable cost over every nonnegative vector deviation. The displayed coefficient, product population, combined score, rank, and policy support matches the source exchangeable-cost linear-production model under the approved a.e. and fixed-priority conventions.

LBG22StrategicRanking.MultidimensionalPr.reason: The target imposes positive linear production coefficient, simplex weights, continuous increasing convex total-effort cost, and continuous strictly increasing nonnegative skill quantiles. This is exactly the source's linear-production, exchangeable-cost multidimensional primitive restriction; allowing zero simplex coordinates is a broader domain that includes every positive-weight source instance.

LBG22StrategicRanking.MultitaskEquilibri.reason: The target uses the independent two-rank population and requires almost every applicant to choose nonnegative measurable and unmeasurable efforts exhausting B while maximizing admission reward minus measurable-effort cost against all hard-budget deviations. This matches the approved hard-equality-budget reading and fixed-priority source model.

LBG22StrategicRanking.MultitaskPrimitive.reason: The target gives B>0, capacity in (0,1), convex increasing nonnegative cost, concave strictly increasing nonnegative production, and regular nonnegative skill quantiles for both tasks. These are the source primitive conditions, with no added frontier or optimizer assumption.

LBG22StrategicRanking.RankingEquilibrium.reason: The target requires a measurable realized score and one full-measure set of applicants whose nonnegative effort maximizes finite-policy reward minus cost against every nonnegative deviation under a fixed score law and priority. This is the source equilibrium definition under the displayed approved strong quantifier order and strict-percentile representation bridge.

LBG22StrategicRanking.RankingPrimitives.reason: The target reproduces the source scalar primitives: a nonnegative baseline where nonnegative strictly convex cost attains zero, continuous concave strictly increasing nonnegative production, and a continuous strictly increasing nonnegative skill quantile on [0,1]. The displayed support confirms all uses remain on these source domains.

LBG22StrategicRanking.RankingScorePriori.reason: The target is the source equilibrium expressed directly with actual score-priority boundary admission: measurable score and almost-everywhere best response against all deviations using one fixed priority key. It matches the approved equilibrium and tie-boundary conventions.

LBG22StrategicRanking.ScorePriorityAbove.reason: For a proposed score and priority, the target says every lexicographically larger score-priority pair has rank strictly above the cutoff. With the displayed lower-contour rank, this is precisely membership above the actual score-priority boundary in the source tie-breaking construction.

LBG22StrategicRanking.ScorePriorityBestR.reason: The target requires nonnegative effort, the source production-times-skill score identity, and reward minus cost at least as large as for every nonnegative deviation, with the score population and priority held fixed. This matches the individual welfare and approved all-deviation best-response reading.

LBG22StrategicRanking.ScorePriorityHardB.reason: The target restricts actual and deviating task efforts to nonnegative pairs summing to B, uses only measurable-skill score for admission, and compares reward minus the displayed multitask cost. On the hard-budget feasible set that cost is p(eM), exactly matching the approved source model.

LBG22StrategicRanking.ScorePriorityMulti.reason: The target quantifies over all nonnegative effort vectors, forms the linear combined score h times the weighted skill-effort sum, charges cost of total effort, and compares finite-policy reward under fixed score priority. This is the source multidimensional best-response problem in its exchangeable linear-production specialization.

LBG22StrategicRanking.SourceFiniteBestRe.reason: The target gives the scalar nonnegative effort, production-times-skill score identity, and utility maximization against every nonnegative deviation using the fixed counterfactual rank and finite reward band. The approved context establishes its strict-percentile form as equivalent to actual score-priority admission for all deviations.

LBG22StrategicRanking.SourceMultidimensi.reason: The target specializes multidimensional welfare to linear production h, coefficient-weighted scores, and exchangeable cost of total effort, and maximizes over every nonnegative vector deviation under the fixed ranking law. This matches the source exchangeable-cost model.

LBG22StrategicRanking.SourceVectorBestRe.reason: The target states the general multidimensional source problem: arbitrary vector cost, coordinatewise production and skill coefficients, summed score, and reward minus cost maximized over every nonnegative vector deviation with fixed ranking. Its broader reusable types specialize to every source instance.

LBG22StrategicRanking.counterfactualTieB.reason: The target changes only the selected applicant's proposed score while holding the population score function and public priority fixed, then measures lower scores plus equal-score applicants weakly preceding that priority. This is the source counterfactual gamma construction.

LBG22StrategicRanking.finiteLowerRankBan.reason: The target selects the greatest finite cutoff strictly below the strict-percentile rank. Under the identity-bound approved priority record, this is the permitted strict-percentile band representation used only through all-deviation equivalence to the source's actual score-priority boundary; all displayed uses respect that scope.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceActualDisadv.reason: The target integrates the finite-policy admission reward of group B over its uniform latent rank using the common two-group realized-score ranking. This is exactly the source definition of disadvantaged-group access under the fixed-priority convention.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceActualGroupW.reason: For a group and latent rank, the target subtracts effort cost from the finite-policy reward at that applicant's actual common-population post-rank. This is the source pointwise group welfare formula.

The target defines the pointwise welfare gap as advantaged-group welfare minus disadvantaged-group welfare at the same latent rank, using the displayed source welfare function. This matches the source definition exactly.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceActualMultit.reason: The target conditions the independent measurable/unmeasurable skill population on actual admission and integrates beta times measurable production plus (1-beta) times unmeasurable production. This is the source conditional weighted school utility, with the approved hard-budget and fixed-priority readings.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceActualTwoLev.reason: The target integrates realized score multiplied by the actual two-level admission reward over the unit applicant population. This is the source private utility E[v lambda(theta_post)], with all ranking and band support displayed.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceDeterministi.reason: The target is exactly c=1-rho, the source cutoff for accepting the highest rho share with probability one under non-randomized admissions.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceEnvironmentC.reason: The target is the CDF of environment-scaled skill under the equal-weight two-group measure. Its displayed map, clamped skill, and group measure match the source mixture CDF f_mix inverse.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceEnvironmentR.reason: The target evaluates the environment-scaled-skill mixture CDF at the applicant's own scaled skill, which is precisely the source environment-scaled pre-effort rank.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceEnvironmentS.reason: The target multiplies the common skill quantile by psiA for group A and psiB for group B. Together with the displayed clamping to the unit rank support, this is the source environment-scaled skill formula.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceFiniteApplic.reason: The target integrates actual finite-policy admission reward minus effort cost over the uniform applicant population. This is the source aggregate applicant welfare definition and specializes to rho minus expected cost under capacity.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceFiniteSchool.reason: The target integrates realized score times actual finite-policy admission reward over the applicant population. This exactly matches the source private school utility definition.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceGroupThresho.reason: The target gives each group's latent-rank cutoff by applying the disadvantaged-threshold construction with the appropriate own and opposite environment multipliers. The displayed mixture CDF and skill support make this equivalent to f inverse of f_mix(c)/psi_G in the source.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceMultidimensi.reason: The target defines coordinate i's pre-effort score coefficient as alpha_i times f_i(theta_i), with ranks restricted through the displayed clamped skill. This is the source weighted multidimensional coefficient.
The target is the finite product of unit-rank measures, so every coordinate rank is independently uniform on the unit interval as required by the source multidimensional model.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourcePureRandomiz.reason: The target returns rho at every reward level, exactly the source one-level pure-randomization policy.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceSocietalUtil.reason: The target integrates post-effort score over the unit applicant population, exactly the source societal utility E[v].

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceTwoGroupMeas.reason: The target assigns half the population to each Boolean group and gives both groups the same uniform latent skill rank. This matches the source equal-sized two-group model with a common skill distribution.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceTwoLevelCuto.reason: The target encodes two-level policy cutoffs 0, c, and 1. With the displayed band representation and fixed-priority convention, this is the source partition at cutoff c.

LBG22StrategicRanking.sourceTwoLevelRewa.reason: The target assigns reward zero below the two-level cutoff and rho/(1-c) above it, exactly the source capacity-preserving two-level reward formula.

LBG22StrategicRanking.tieBrokenRank.reason: The target measures the lower score contour together with equal-score applicants whose public priority is weakly below the selected applicant's. This is the source tie-broken post-effort rank gamma; the displayed support and approved record fix the same priority across actual and counterfactual scores.
